tables.name: stip_products
tables.label: Stipulations: supplier products
tables.description: One row per supplier product per fuel. Eligibility limits, curve end and pricing window. Updated monthly from the stipulation sheet.

columns.name: product_key
columns.label: Product key
columns.description: Unique key: family + fuel, e.g. bg_matrix_e

columns.name: product_family
columns.label: Product family
columns.description: Family key shared across fuels, e.g. bg_matrix

columns.name: supplier_group
columns.label: Supplier group
columns.description: Matches the Current supplier option value: bg, corona, crown, drax, edf, engie, npower, shell, smartest, total

columns.name: supplier
columns.label: Supplier
columns.description: Display name

columns.name: product
columns.label: Product
columns.description: Display product name (blank if the supplier has one product)

columns.name: fuel
columns.label: Fuel
columns.description: E = electricity, G = gas

columns.name: min_aq_kwh
columns.label: Min aq kwh
columns.description: Minimum annual consumption (new business)

columns.name: min_aq_renewal_kwh
columns.label: Min aq renewal kwh
columns.description: Minimum annual consumption on renewals; blank = same as new business

columns.name: max_aq_kwh
columns.label: Max aq kwh
columns.description: Maximum annual consumption; blank = no maximum

columns.name: max_aq_exclusive
columns.label: Max aq exclusive
columns.description: True = AQ must be strictly below max_aq_kwh (e.g. BG '<1GWh')

columns.name: eoc_mode
columns.label: Eoc mode
columns.description: How the end of curve is worked out

columns.name: eoc_date
columns.label: Eoc date
columns.description: End of curve when eoc_mode = fixed_date

columns.name: eoc_months
columns.label: Eoc months
columns.description: Months added when eoc_mode is months_from_today or months_from_month_start

columns.name: latest_start_mode
columns.label: Latest start mode
columns.description: How the latest contract start date is worked out

columns.name: latest_start_date
columns.label: Latest start date
columns.description: Latest start when latest_start_mode = fixed_date

columns.name: latest_start_months
columns.label: Latest start months
columns.description: Months for the latest start rule (new business)

columns.name: latest_start_months_renewal
columns.label: Latest start months renewal
columns.description: Months for the latest start rule on renewals; blank = same as new business

columns.name: latest_start_note
columns.label: Latest start note
columns.description: Shown after the 'start date must be on or before' message

columns.name: max_term_months
columns.label: Max term months
columns.description: Hard cap on contract length; blank = curve end only

columns.name: min_term_months
columns.label: Min term months
columns.description: Minimum contract length; blank = 1

columns.name: active
columns.label: Active
columns.description: False hides the product from the calculator

columns.name: sort_order
columns.label: Sort order
columns.description: Display order for ties and lists

columns.name: stip_month
columns.label: Stip month
columns.description: Month of the stipulation sheet these values come from

columns.name: credit_notes
columns.label: Credit notes
columns.description: Credit restrictions, as on the sheet

columns.name: other_notes
columns.label: Other notes
columns.description: Other stipulations, as on the sheet

columns.name: changes_vs_previous
columns.label: Changes vs previous
columns.description: Changes versus the last communicated stipulations

columns.name: open_question
columns.label: Open question
columns.description: Anything not settled by the sheet that needs confirming

tables.name: stip_comms_bands
tables.label: Stipulations: max commission bands
tables.description: Max commission p/kWh. For a deal, rows matching applies_to and fuel are tested in priority order (lowest first); the first row whose conditions all match gives the rate.

columns.name: band_key
columns.label: Band key
columns.description: Unique key

columns.name: applies_to
columns.label: Applies to
columns.description: Product family key (e.g. bg_matrix) or supplier group key (e.g. npower) this row applies to

columns.name: fuel
columns.label: Fuel
columns.description: Fuel the band applies to

columns.name: priority
columns.label: Priority
columns.description: Lower is tested first

columns.name: aq_min_kwh
columns.label: Aq min kwh
columns.description: AQ at or above; blank = no lower limit

columns.name: aq_max_kwh
columns.label: Aq max kwh
columns.description: AQ at or below; blank = no upper limit

columns.name: sectors
columns.label: Sectors
columns.description: Comma-separated sector keys the band is limited to; blank = any sector

columns.name: start_on_or_before
columns.label: Start on or before
columns.description: Contract start on or before this date; blank = any

columns.name: start_after
columns.label: Start after
columns.description: Contract start after this date; blank = any

columns.name: months_to_start_gt
columns.label: Months to start gt
columns.description: Months between quote date and start date greater than this; blank = any

columns.name: role
columns.label: Role
columns.description: Sales role the band applies to

columns.name: bg_trial
columns.label: Bg trial
columns.description: British Gas 3p trial running

columns.name: comms_p_per_kwh
columns.label: Comms p per kwh
columns.description: Max commission in pence per kWh

columns.name: note
columns.label: Note
columns.description: Where the rate comes from

tables.name: stip_rules
tables.label: Stipulations: eligibility rules
tables.description: Checks that rule a product out (fail), flag it (warn) or cap its term (term_cap). A row fires when condition 1 and, if filled, condition 2 both match.

columns.name: rule_key
columns.label: Rule key
columns.description: Unique key

columns.name: applies_to
columns.label: Applies to
columns.description: Product family key (e.g. bg_matrix) or supplier group key (e.g. npower) this row applies to

columns.name: fuel
columns.label: Fuel
columns.description: Fuel the rule applies to

columns.name: field1
columns.label: Field1
columns.description: Deal input: always, sector, structure, trading_years, dd, smart, hh, micro, indep, renewal, aq_kwh, start_date, bg_trial, role

columns.name: op1
columns.label: Op1
columns.description: Comparison for condition 1

columns.name: value1
columns.label: Value1
columns.description: Value for condition 1 (comma list for 'in'; YYYY-MM-DD for start_date)

columns.name: field2
columns.label: Field2
columns.description: Optional second deal input

columns.name: op2
columns.label: Op2
columns.description: Comparison for condition 2

columns.name: value2
columns.label: Value2
columns.description: Value for condition 2

columns.name: outcome
columns.label: Outcome
columns.description: What happens when the rule fires

columns.name: cap_months
columns.label: Cap months
columns.description: Term cap in months when outcome = term_cap

columns.name: message
columns.label: Message
columns.description: Text shown to the salesperson

columns.name: sort_order
columns.label: Sort order
columns.description: Display order within a product
